docent.tldr: An art museum companion for iPhone. Photograph a piece, confirm what it is, then talk with a guide about its history out loud.

alpha-engine.tldr: Systematic swing-trading research engine. Quant and AI news-research signals feed a deterministic, rules-based decision engine: the AI researches and scores, it never decides.

tiny-llm.tldr: Learning how LLMs are trained, two ways: a small GPT built and pretrained from scratch, and a LoRA fine-tune of Qwen3-0.6B.
